title: DreamSeed
description: GOBLIN output. Free lateral brainstorm from any raw input. NO RECEIPT = NO CLAIM. GOBLINs may dream everything but prove nothing.

source_refs.description: Pointers to raw input sources. Files, URLs, snippets, labels — anything.

raw_fragments.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim extracts from the raw input. No interpretation yet.

motifs.description: Recurring patterns, themes, or tensions GOBLIN notices across fragments.

wild_connections.description: Lateral leaps. Associations to other domains, memories, or absurd analogies. No filter.

why_it_feels_interesting.description: GOBLIN's gut read. Why does this signal feel alive? Not an argument — a feeling.

input_type.description: Optional: type of raw input (pdf, tweet, article, noise, failure, fragment, dream, other).

claim_status.description: Always NO_CLAIM. GOBLINs do not make claims.

authority.description: Always false. DreamSeeds carry no authority.

actor.description: Always GOBLIN. Only GOBLINs emit DreamSeeds.

notes.description: Optional freeform GOBLIN notes. Ephemeral — not promoted.
